visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white cold-shoulder top, speaks directly to the camera with high energy and wide eyes. Animated yellow gold coins with dollar signs fall around her in a digital overlay. The background is a clean indoor setting with a white slatted wall. (2) She turns her body toward a kitchen counter and reaches into an oven, pulling out a vibrant orange rectangular box. Her movements are quick and deliberate. (3) She presents the orange box, which features large gold Chinese characters, closely to the camera. The setting shifts slightly to a kitchen environment with visible counter surfaces. (4) The scene cuts to a close-up of the box's interior, showing six individually wrapped pastries in clear plastic packaging with circular logos. (5) She holds up two separate pastries, one purple and one golden-brown, demonstrating their size and appearance relative to her hands. (6) A macro close-up reveals a cross-section of a pastry with a dark red bean filling surrounding a large, solid yellow salted egg yolk. (7) She takes a large bite of a pastry, closing her eyes and nodding with an exaggerated expression of delight and satisfaction. (8) Two hands break apart a purple-swirled taro pastry on a wooden cutting board, revealing a viscous, bright orange liquid yolk center that slowly oozes out. (9) She continues to hold the broken taro pastry, pointing at the runny center with her finger while talking enthusiastically. (10) The video concludes with her holding the full orange box again, gesturing toward it with a smile as text overlays appear at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy female speech in Mandarin Chinese, accompanied by a bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong percussive beat (~124 BPM). The vocal tone is extremely excited. (2) At 5 seconds, a distinct metallic click sound occurs, resembling an oven door opening. The primary vocal continues without pause, maintaining a high pitch and rapid rate. (3) Between 10 and 15 seconds, the crisp rustling of plastic wrappers is audible beneath the narration. The BGM remains steady in the background. (4) A male voice briefly interjects with a questioning tone, creating a momentary dialogue effect. (5) At 30 seconds, a sharp, resonant crunch sound (food bite) is heard, followed immediately by an appreciative vocal sigh ("Mmm"). (6) Throughout the middle section, the female speaker details ingredients with clear articulation and high arousal. The BGM provides a consistent rhythmic bed. (7) The final 20 seconds feature a slightly faster speech rate as the speaker delivers promotional details. The BGM continues until a hard cut at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for 'Hui Love It' mid-autumn festival pastries. It uses high-energy delivery and close-up 'food porn' visuals (specifically the runny egg yolk center) to entice viewers, culminating in a specific discount code 'moon93' for purchasing.
